prs.title: Add missing license headers
prs.bug: Many scripts, manifests and source files lacked the MPL license header, which the mozilla-central license linter flags after vendoring.
prs.rule: Every tracked source/config file (rs, py, sh, kt, swift, js, css, html, xml, properties, gradle) must start with the MPL-2.0 header.
prs.detect: CI script over `git ls-files` that checks the first ~5 lines for 'This Source Code Form is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public' (allowing a shebang first), with an allowlist for generated/third-party files; or run m-c's `license` linter config.

prs.title: Fix file permission issues
prs.bug: Non-scripts (png, yml) were marked executable and sourced shell scripts lacked a shebang, tripping m-c's file-perms linter.
prs.rule: Files with the executable bit must start with a shebang; data files (png, yml, md, json...) must never be executable.
prs.detect: CI script: `git ls-files -s` mode 100755 => first bytes must be '#!'; mode 100755 on known non-script extensions => error.

prs.title: nimbus doesn't use/need glean-build
prs.bug: nimbus kept an unused `glean-build` build-dependency, pulling extra crates (xshell...) into the dependency/license summaries.
prs.rule: No unused [dependencies]/[build-dependencies] in component Cargo.toml files.
prs.detect: Run `cargo machete` (or `cargo udeps` on nightly) in CI with a small ignore list for build.rs/feature-only deps.

prs.title: Bug 1931812 - Don't reingest the DB on each query benchmark
prs.bug: Query benchmarks re-ingested the whole Suggest DB on every iteration, inflating benchmark time.

prs.title: fix: set proper filter_expression format
prs.bug: JEXL filter context lacked the `env` wrapper and used `app_version` instead of `version`, so real Remote Settings filter expressions never matched.

prs.title: fix: downgrade regex to 1.9
prs.bug: Components required regex 1.10.5 while mozilla-central vendors 1.9, blocking vendoring.
prs.rule: Dependency version requirements must be satisfiable by the crate versions currently vendored in mozilla-central.
prs.detect: CI script that fetches (or keeps a pinned copy of) m-c's Cargo.lock and fails if any a-s Cargo.toml requirement's minimum version exceeds the m-c version (semver compare per crate).

prs.title: Fix ranker docstring
prs.bug: A doc comment line used `//` instead of `///`, silently dropping the 'Return' line from the exported function's docs.
prs.rule: Don't interleave plain `//` comment lines inside a `///` doc block.
prs.detect: Regex/ast-grep: a line matching `^\s*//[^/!]` sandwiched between `^\s*///` lines (multiline rg: `///.*\n\s*//[^/!].*\n\s*///`).

prs.title: Bug 1929375 - Fix schema::clear_database() and add a migration
prs.bug: `clear_database()` did not clear tables added by later migrations (geonames, ingested_records, rs_cache, ...), so migrations that should force re-ingestion left stale data.
prs.rule: Every table in the schema must be cleared by `clear_database()` or be on an explicit allowlist.
prs.detect: Test-harness: open a fully migrated DB, populate it (or insert one row per table), call clear_database(), then iterate `sqlite_master` tables and assert each is empty unless allowlisted; alternatively a CI script comparing CREATE TABLE names in schema.rs with the clear list.

prs.title: Bug 1928544 - For weather suggestions, don't match on airport codes or abbreviations when they're the only term in the query
prs.bug: Weather suggestions matched on airport codes/abbreviations when they were the only query term.

prs.title: Properly close webext storage database close function
prs.bug: The webext-storage close function did not actually close the underlying DB connection.

prs.title: Fix Suggest icon metrics
prs.bug: Icon download time was measured as ingestion time because the icon path skipped the download timer.

prs.title: Bug 1925601 - Fix the iOS build (again)
prs.bug: The iOS build hack used `awk` that printed the patched module.modulemap to stdout instead of writing it, so the viaduct header was still missing.
prs.rule: After building the xcframework, every header in Headers/ must be referenced by Modules/module.modulemap.
prs.detect: CI post-build check in the swift build task: list Headers/*.h and grep each in module.modulemap; fail on missing. (shellcheck does not catch an awk without redirect.)

prs.title: Bug 1925601 - Fix the iOS build
prs.bug: The iOS xcframework lacked RustViaductFFI.h because viaduct is not a UniFFI component, breaking the iOS build.
prs.rule: After building the xcframework, every header in Headers/ must be referenced by module.modulemap and every component's FFI header must be present.
prs.detect: Same xcframework consistency check as #6422: compare the set of `*FFI.h` expected from megazord deps with Headers/ and module.modulemap.

prs.title: Fix up some internal dependences.
prs.bug: Several crates kept unused deps (ffi-support, nss_build_common, libsqlite3-sys) left over from older FFI approaches.
prs.rule: No unused dependencies in component Cargo.toml files.
prs.detect: `cargo machete` / `cargo udeps` in CI.

prs.title: Fix: index new topic guides
prs.bug: New topic-guide pages were added but not listed in docs/SUMMARY.md, so mdbook never published them.
prs.rule: Every docs/**/*.md page must be reachable from SUMMARY.md (or allowlisted).
prs.detect: CI script: collect links from docs/SUMMARY.md and diff against `git ls-files docs/*.md`; fail on orphans.

prs.title: fix: remove deleted file and link
prs.bug: SUMMARY.md linked to a document that had been deleted.
prs.rule: All links in SUMMARY.md (and docs) must resolve.
prs.detect: mdbook-linkcheck or a CI script checking that each SUMMARY.md target path exists.

prs.title: Fix OpenSSL license URL
prs.bug: The OpenSSL license file URL used by the dependency summary moved on the upstream site.

prs.title: fix: remove empty variable
prs.bug: generate_docs.sh referenced an unset variable ($DOC_DIR) and aborted under `set -u`.
prs.rule: Shell scripts must pass shellcheck (no referenced-but-unassigned variables).
prs.detect: Run shellcheck on all *.sh in CI; SC2154 flags `$DOC_DIR` referenced but never assigned.

prs.title: Fix the path to the megazord symbols when uploading (backport #6389)
prs.bug: Backport of #6389: symbol upload pointed at the wrong extraction directory.

prs.title: Fix the path to the megazord symbols when uploading
prs.bug: fetch-content extracted the symbols archive one directory deeper than the upload command expected.

prs.title: Fix: add default values for suggest component
prs.bug: Optional fields/args of Suggest's exported Records/constructors had no UniFFI defaults, forcing consumers to pass every argument (Bug 1919998).
prs.rule: Option<T> fields of uniffi Records and Option<T> args of exported constructors/methods should declare `default = None` unless explicitly opted out.
prs.detect: Custom syn/ast-grep check: in `#[derive(uniffi::Record)]` structs flag `Option<...>` fields without `#[uniffi(default = ...)]`; in `#[uniffi::constructor]`/`#[uniffi::method]` flag Option args not listed in `default(...)`; UDL: `T?` dictionary members without `= null`.

prs.title: Return non-zero exit code when symbol uploading fails
prs.bug: upload_symbols.py ignored the False return of upload_symbols(), so the release task passed even though symbol upload failed.
prs.rule: Automation scripts must not discard success/failure return values; main() must exit non-zero on failure.
prs.detect: Custom Python AST check (or ruff plugin): an expression-statement call to a locally defined function whose return statements are all bool literals is flagged as an ignored status.

prs.title: Revert "Expose webext-storage bridged engine logic"
prs.bug: Revert of webext-storage bridged-engine exposure because the m-c side was backed out.

prs.title: Back out "Support for a new "close all inactive tabs" command."
prs.bug: Backout of the 'close all inactive tabs' feature.

prs.title: Bug 1908802 - Handle deleted suggest records
prs.bug: Deleted Remote Settings records lack a `type` field, so type-filtered server queries never delivered deletions and stale suggestions stayed ingested.

prs.title: Fix record types for SuggestionProvider::AmpMobile
prs.bug: SuggestionProvider::AmpMobile wrongly included the AmpWikipedia (desktop) record type.

prs.title: Removing pending commands for Close Tab should only affect devices th…
prs.bug: Removing pending close-tab commands deleted commands for devices that had not synced yet.

prs.title: FxaError::Other error should show a description of the other error
prs.bug: FxaError::Other carried no message, so consumers only saw 'other error' with no cause.
prs.rule: Catch-all variants of public (FFI) error enums must carry a reason string.
prs.detect: Custom lint over `#[derive(uniffi::Error)]`/UDL `[Error]` enums: a variant named Other/Unexpected*/Unknown* with no fields (or whose `#[error]` format has no interpolation) is an error.

prs.title: Refactor fxa command encryption to avoid duplicated code
prs.bug: Refactor of fxa command encryption into a shared keys module.

prs.title: Add missing license to support/types crate.
prs.bug: components/support/types/Cargo.toml had no `license` field, blocking vendoring into mozilla-central.
prs.rule: Every workspace Cargo.toml must declare `license = "MPL-2.0"`.
prs.detect: CI script over `cargo metadata --no-deps` asserting each package has license == MPL-2.0 (or cargo-deny `[licenses]` with private crates checked).

prs.title: chore: Update vendoring should error if a subprocess has an issue.
prs.bug: update-moz-central-vendoring.py ignored subprocess failures and reported success.
prs.rule: subprocess.run in automation must use check=True or inspect returncode.
prs.detect: Existing ruff/pylint rule PLW1510 (subprocess-run-without-check) on automation/, tools/, taskcluster/.

prs.title: Fixes tests that depend  map ordering
prs.bug: Tests compared serde_json maps in a fixed key order that only held because `preserve_order` was enabled via workspace feature unification.
prs.rule: Tests must not depend on HashMap/serde_json::Map iteration order unless the crate itself enables an ordered map.
prs.detect: CI job that runs each crate's tests in isolation (`cargo test -p <crate>` / cargo-hack --each-package) so feature-unification-dependent behaviour fails; optionally flag expect-test snapshots of Map Debug output.

prs.title: Bug 1889440 - Fixing the suggest database migration
prs.bug: A Suggest migration passed two SQL statements to `execute()`, which ran only the first, leaving upgraded DBs without a table.
prs.rule: Never pass multiple SQL statements to execute()/execute_cached()/prepare(); use execute_batch. Every migration must keep the upgraded schema identical to a fresh one.
prs.detect: Custom lint/ast-grep: string-literal (or const) SQL argument to `.execute(`/`.execute_cached(`/`.prepare(` containing `;` followed by another statement keyword. Test-harness: fresh-vs-migrated schema equality test (sql_support MigratedDatabaseFile::assert_schema_matches_new_database) required for every component with migrations.

prs.title: Uplift fix for Bug 1887071 - Clear out tokens/keys when starting an oauth flow
prs.bug: Starting a new OAuth flow kept the previous session token/keys, causing Bug 1887071.

prs.title: Bug 1883413 - Handle `Disconnect` event from `AuthIssues` state
prs.bug: The FxA AuthIssues state did not handle the Disconnect event.

prs.title: Fxa state checker: handle public events that immediately transition to a new state
prs.bug: The FxA state checker did not handle public events that transition immediately to a terminal state, producing Sentry errors.

prs.title: Prevent outgoing scrubbed credit card records
prs.bug: An `unwrap()` inside a query_map closure (marked 'XXX') panicked on bad rows, and scrubbed credit cards were uploaded.
prs.rule: Library code must not unwrap() on fallible results from DB rows/external data.
prs.detect: clippy::unwrap_used (and expect_used) denied in non-test code of components (baseline existing uses with #[allow]); additionally grep for `unwrap()` with an XXX/TODO comment on the same line. The scrubbed-record upload part is not lintable.

prs.title: Fixes race condition in unit tests for push
prs.bug: A new push test used the static MockConnection without taking the shared test lock, racing other tests.
prs.rule: Tests that touch process-global state (mockall static contexts, global logger) must be serialized.
prs.detect: Custom lint for test modules: if a test calls `Mock*::*_context()` or a helper that relies on it (get_test_manager), it must also call `get_lock(&MTX)` or be `#[serial]`; flag tests in the same module that don't.

prs.title: Fixup JEXL transform panic
prs.bug: eventLastSeen returned usize::MAX as a count, overflowing when added to the starting bucket and panicking inside a JEXL transform, which poisoned the evaluator mutex.
prs.rule: Code reachable from JEXL transforms/FFI must use checked/saturating arithmetic and never panic.
prs.detect: Enable clippy::arithmetic_side_effects (and clippy::panic, indexing_slicing) for nimbus stateful behavior/targeting modules; add a test-harness that evaluates every transform with boundary arguments.

prs.title: Bug 1875113 - Handle JSON errors when parsing attachments
prs.bug: Invalid JSON in one Suggest attachment aborted ingestion instead of marking the record unparsable.

prs.title: Don't report sentry errors for metadata view times too long
prs.bug: Expected 'view time too long' metadata errors were reported to Sentry, creating noise.

prs.title: [DISCO-2718] Suggest: fix: Add score to AMP suggestions
prs.bug: AMP suggestions lacked a score, so ranking against AMO suggestions was wrong.

prs.title: Make ErrorPath handle multi-token errors
prs.bug: FML ErrorPath computed wrong spans for errors spanning multiple tokens (reported at 0,0).

prs.title: Bug 1873218: Do not fail verify connection if there is no local uaid
prs.bug: verify_connection failed when there was no local UAID instead of returning no changes.

prs.title: Update tests to use recordPastEvent to handle 01 Jan boundary (backport #6032)
prs.bug: Backport of #6032: event-store tests built dates from Utc::now() and failed across the Jan 1 boundary.
prs.rule: Tests must not depend on the current wall-clock date.
prs.detect: Custom lint: in #[cfg(test)] code under components/nimbus flag `Utc::now()`/`SystemTime::now()`/`Timestamp::now()` used with calendar arithmetic (Duration, with_month, Interval::Months/Weeks); plus a periodic CI run under libfaketime at boundary dates.

prs.title: Update tests to use recordPastEvent to handle 01 Jan boundary
prs.bug: Event-store tests advanced counters from Utc::now(), so results changed across the Jan 1 year boundary.
prs.rule: Tests must not depend on the current wall-clock date.
prs.detect: Custom lint flagging wall-clock `now()` in tests that do calendar math; periodic faketime CI run at Dec 31/Jan 1.

prs.title: Fixes DISCO-2712: Add an `ON DELETE CASCADE` action to `prefix_keywords.suggestion_id`. (backport #6016)
prs.bug: Backport of #6016: prefix_keywords.suggestion_id lacked ON DELETE CASCADE.
prs.rule: Every REFERENCES/FOREIGN KEY clause must declare an explicit ON DELETE action.
prs.detect: Schema test: on a fresh DB iterate tables and `PRAGMA foreign_key_list(t)`; fail when on_delete == 'NO ACTION' unless allowlisted. Or regex over schema SQL: `REFERENCES\s+\w+\([^)]*\)(?!\s*ON DELETE)`.

prs.title: Revert "Uniffi webext-storage component"
prs.bug: Revert of the UniFFI webext-storage component.

prs.title: Fixes DISCO-2712: Add an `ON DELETE CASCADE` action to `prefix_keywords.suggestion_id`.
prs.bug: prefix_keywords.suggestion_id referenced suggestions(id) without ON DELETE CASCADE, so re-ingesting AMO/Pocket suggestions failed with FOREIGN KEY constraint errors.
prs.rule: Every REFERENCES/FOREIGN KEY clause must declare an explicit ON DELETE action.
prs.detect: Schema test using `PRAGMA foreign_key_list` on a fresh DB (on_delete != 'NO ACTION' unless allowlisted).

prs.title: Fixes FeatureHolderAny initializer not public
prs.bug: The Swift FeatureHolderAny initializer was internal, so firefox-ios could not construct it.

prs.title: Don't run PRAGMA optimize on close of read-only connection
prs.bug: PRAGMA optimize was run when closing read-only places connections, failing and spamming logs.

prs.title: [DISCO-2661] Suggest: fix: use lowercase keyword to find suggestion (backport #5892)
prs.bug: Backport of #5892: suggestion lookup used the un-lowercased keyword.

prs.title: [DISCO-2661] Suggest: fix: use lowercase keyword to find suggestion
prs.bug: Suggestion lookup used the query keyword as typed, so mixed-case input never matched lowercase stored keywords.

prs.title: Fixes DISCO-2637: Replace `SuggestionQuery` options with `providers`. [firefox-android: linabutler/DISCO-2637] [firefox-ios: linabutler/DISCO-2637]
prs.bug: API change replacing include_sponsored flags with a providers list.

prs.title: Document that push `KeyInfo` elements are base64 encoded. Fixes #2069
prs.bug: Documentation that push KeyInfo values are base64.

prs.title: Fix rust log forwarder bindings for Focus iOS
prs.bug: After #5840 the Focus iOS megazord did not include rust-log-forwarder (crate dep, re-export and FFI header), breaking Focus builds.
prs.rule: Each megazord must re-export and include headers for every UniFFI component in its dependency closure.
prs.detect: CI script: compute UniFFI crates reachable from megazords/ios-rust/focus via `cargo metadata`, then assert each has `pub use` in src/lib.rs and `#import "<name>FFI.h"` in MozillaRustComponents.h.

prs.title: Fixing `./gradlew ktlintFormat`
prs.bug: ./gradlew ktlintFormat failed on newer JDKs without --add-opens.

prs.title: Avoid `brew update-reset` each time we check Swift formatting
prs.bug: Removed an obsolete `brew update-reset` CI hack.

prs.title: Removes incorrect comment declaring viaduct not safe for binary bodies
prs.bug: Removed a stale comment about binary bodies in viaduct.

prs.title: Fixes DISCO-2605: Replace template parameters in AMP suggestion URLs.
prs.bug: Feature: cook template parameters in AMP URLs.

prs.title: Fixes DISCO-2587: Generate Swift bindings for the Suggest Rust component.
prs.bug: Feature: generate Swift bindings for Suggest.

prs.title: Fixes SYNC-3866: Remove the read-only transaction from `fetch_tree_with_depth`.
prs.bug: fetch_tree_with_depth held an unnecessary read transaction, causing failures when called concurrently.

prs.title: Suggest: fixes [DISCO-2564] - Store unknown records
prs.bug: Feature: track unparsable Remote Settings records.

prs.title: suggest: Ensure that each store test uses a unique database
prs.bug: Suggest store tests could share named shared-cache in-memory databases, cross-contaminating each other.
prs.rule: Each test must use a unique database; no duplicated `file:NAME?mode=memory&cache=shared` literals.
prs.detect: CI script: rg all `file:[^?]+\?mode=memory&cache=shared` literals and fail on duplicate names across the repo's tests (or require a unique_test_store() helper).

prs.title: Update files that are failing via swiftformat
prs.bug: An unpinned swiftformat upgrade started failing CI on previously accepted code.
prs.rule: Pin formatter/linter versions used in CI.
prs.detect: CI config: install swiftformat/swiftlint at pinned versions (e.g., via mint or a Package.swift tool dependency) and fail the lint job if `--version` differs from the pinned value.

prs.title: Fixing KeyErrors in the branch build transform
prs.bug: The branch-build transform raised KeyError when firefox-android/ios params were absent.

prs.title: Fixes DISCO-2571: Fix re-ingesting icons in the Suggest Rust component
prs.bug: Icons were stored with INSERT instead of INSERT OR REPLACE, so re-ingesting an updated icon hit a unique-constraint error.

prs.title: Fixes DISCO-2569: Prepare to support other types of suggestions in the Suggest Rust component
prs.bug: Refactor preparing Suggest for other suggestion types.

prs.title: Fixes DISCO-2565: Ignore unknown Remote Settings records in the Suggest collection
prs.bug: Unknown or malformed Remote Settings records did not advance the last-ingest timestamp.

prs.title: Fixes DISCO-2566: Improve Remote Settings client ergonomics for the Suggest component
prs.bug: Remote Settings client ergonomics refactor.

prs.title: Fix tabs timestamp being reset to zero on desktop
prs.bug: When used as a bridged engine the tabs engine stored a zero last-sync timestamp, resetting desktop's tabs timestamp.

prs.title: Fixes DISCO-2493: Add tests for the Suggest component
prs.bug: Tests for the Suggest component.

prs.title: Fix nimbus-fml breaking deterministic builds
prs.bug: nimbus-fml used HashMap in serialized/generated structures, making its output nondeterministic and breaking reproducible builds.
prs.rule: Code generators/serialized manifests must use ordered collections.
prs.detect: clippy.toml in components/support/nimbus-fml: `disallowed-types = ["std::collections::HashMap", "std::collections::HashSet"]` (use BTreeMap/IndexMap), or enable clippy::iter_over_hash_type for that crate; plus a test that generates output twice and compares bytes.

prs.title: Bug 1843907 Fixup URI crash for Fenix
prs.bug: Nimbus ArgumentProcessor called query APIs on opaque (non-hierarchical) URIs, crashing Fenix.
prs.rule: Check Uri.isHierarchical before calling Uri.getQueryParameter*/queryParameterNames.
prs.detect: Custom detekt rule: flag calls to `getQueryParameter`, `getQueryParameters`, `queryParameterNames`, `getBooleanQueryParameter` in a function without a preceding `isHierarchical` check.

prs.title: Fixes depedency summaries
prs.bug: A PR merged with a stale DEPENDENCIES.md because auto-merge only required the run-tests job, not the dependency check.
prs.rule: The dependency-summary/audit check must be a required status on every PR that changes Cargo.lock or manifests.
prs.detect: Branch protection/auto-merge config: require the dependency-check job; the job runs `tools/dependency_summary.py --check` whenever Cargo.lock changes.

prs.title: Fixes DISCO-2470: Implement the foundation of a Firefox Suggest component
prs.bug: Feature: initial Suggest component.

prs.title: Fixes SYNC-3801: Improve local dev of rust-components-swift

prs.title: Fixes EXP-3655: Expose getter for coenrolling feature ids in FML client and udl

prs.title: Fix for the swift-build artifacts dir

prs.bug: Revert of removing fxaccount migration support due to firefox-ios breakage.

prs.detect: CI script: `taskgraph full -p taskcluster/test/params/<each>.yml` for all param files; a custom check that a task's artifact names are not duplicated across artifacts and release-artifacts.

prs.title: Fixing the decision task breakage

prs.rule: Generate the full taskgraph for every parameter set in PR CI.
prs.detect: CI script running `taskgraph full` against every file in taskcluster/test/params/ on PRs touching taskcluster/.

prs.title: Fixes EXP-3624: Allow coenrollment in Nimbus FML
prs.bug: Feature: coenrollment in Nimbus FML.

prs.bug: Dependency bump for RUSTSEC-2023-0044 (openssl, h2).

prs.title: Ensure the nimbus-cli experiments aren't overwritten on restart

prs.title: Ensure places/origins are removed when a bookmark with no visits etc is removed.

prs.title: Don't write duplicate entries to dependency-licenses.xml
prs.bug: dependency_summary.py wrote duplicate entries to dependency-licenses.xml.

prs.title: Renaming Sync metrics to prevent name collision
prs.bug: Renamed sync metrics to *_v2 to avoid Glean name collisions when moving telemetry into a-s.

prs.title: Fixing the nimbus-cli index
prs.bug: The nimbus-cli assemble task published to the nimbus-fml.latest index route (copy-paste), clobbering the FML index.
prs.rule: Taskcluster index routes must be unique across tasks and name the task's own artifact.
prs.detect: CI script over the generated full taskgraph: collect all `index.*` routes and fail on duplicates; optionally assert the route segment equals the task's `nimbus-binary`/artifact name.

prs.title: Don't generate module map for remote settings
prs.bug: Cleanup: stop generating an unneeded Swift module map.

prs.title: Adding documentation on how to handle breaking changes
prs.bug: Docs on handling breaking changes.

prs.title: nimbus-gradle-plugin arch fix
prs.bug: The nimbus gradle plugin still selected the musl FML binary after the build switched to gnu.

prs.title: Don't build nightlies if there isn't a new commit
prs.bug: Feature: skip nightly builds when there is no new commit.

prs.title: Handle incoming history records with a null title
prs.bug: Incoming history records with an explicit null title failed to deserialize, because `#[serde(default)]` only covers missing fields.
prs.rule: Incoming sync-payload String/collection fields with #[serde(default)] must also tolerate explicit null.

prs.title: Fixing the branch build code (gh-5502) [firefox-android: main]

prs.title: Fixes sync15 not referencing the megazord
prs.bug: sync15's uniffi.toml lacked cdylib_name = "megazord", so Kotlin tried to load a nonexistent per-crate library and DeviceType crashed in Fenix.
prs.rule: Every component bundled in the Android megazord must set `[bindings.kotlin] cdylib_name = "megazord"`.
prs.detect: CI script: for each crate depended on by megazords/full that has a uniffi.toml or .udl/uniffi exports, parse uniffi.toml and assert cdylib_name == 'megazord'.

prs.bug: SQLCipher made a trivial license text change, breaking the dependency check.

prs.title: Fixing the objcopy path when building the megazord

prs.title: Places migration fix

prs.detect: Custom lint flagging `Utc::now()` in nimbus tests that query Weeks/Months intervals; periodic CI run under libfaketime on different weekdays.

prs.title: Ensure we only truncate at char bounds

prs.rule: Never truncate or slice a String at an arbitrary byte index.

prs.detect: Custom lint: in a test module where any test takes TEST_LOCK/#[serial], every test calling set_logger/set_max_level must do the same.

prs.bug: Removed obsolete android-components projects from CI config after upstream removal.

prs.title: Fix the `test_logging` test

prs.rule: Tests mutating process-global state must be serialized.
prs.detect: Require `#[serial]` (serial_test) or a shared lock on tests calling set_logger/set_max_level; custom lint checks this.

prs.title: Don't use workspace dependencies for UniFFI.

prs.detect: CI check (at that time): forbid `workspace = true` in components/**/Cargo.toml; more generally a periodic job that vendors a-s into a pinned m-c checkout (`mach vendor rust`) and fails on errors.

prs.title: Fix serialization and deserialization of `Option<DeviceType>` in sync15.
prs.bug: RemoteClient deserialized unknown device types as Some(Unknown) but refused to serialize Unknown, so records could not roundtrip.
prs.rule: Serialize/Deserialize impls of sync payload types must roundtrip, including unknown enum values.
prs.detect: Test-harness: property/roundtrip test (deserialize -> serialize -> deserialize) for each payload type with unknown enum strings and nulls; flag enums whose Serialize errors on a variant Deserialize can produce.

prs.title: Don't report URL parsing errors
prs.bug: Known invalid-URL parse errors from Fenix were reported to Sentry as noise.

prs.title: Update incorrect comments and add new comments about record IDs
prs.bug: Comment updates about record IDs.

prs.title: Fix iOS  naming conflict
prs.bug: autofill and logins both exported a top-level `create_key`, colliding in the shared Swift module for iOS.
prs.rule: Top-level names exported by components that share one Swift module must be unique.
prs.detect: uniffi checker in CI: generate Swift for all iOS megazord components (library mode), collect top-level `public func`/type/typealias names per component and fail on duplicates (or compile all generated files together on every PR).

prs.title: Don't delete all existing tab records if we don't have any to apply.

prs.title: Fixes swift warnings

prs.rule: Swift wrappers must build with warnings as errors.
prs.detect: `SWIFT_TREAT_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS=YES` / `-warnings-as-errors` for the wrapper sources in CI.

prs.title: Autofill scrubbing fixes
prs.bug: Autofill reset_storage opened an unchecked transaction and never committed it, so scrub_encrypted_data's last-sync reset was rolled back; empty ciphertext was also reported to Sentry.
prs.rule: A transaction created in a function must be committed, explicitly rolled back, or returned.
prs.detect: Custom lint (dylint or ast-grep): `let $TX = $DB.(unchecked_transaction|transaction|begin_transaction)()?` in a fn body with no `$TX.commit()` and no move of `$TX` out of the function => error (allow via attribute for intentional read guards).

prs.title: Fix deprecation warnings in iOS Swift Keychain Wrapper code
prs.bug: Keychain wrapper code used deprecated APIs and produced warnings in consumer builds.
prs.rule: Swift wrappers must build with warnings (including deprecations) as errors.
prs.detect: `-warnings-as-errors` for wrapper sources in CI.

prs.title: Fixed error field name for tabs error
prs.bug: Tabs.swift threw UnexpectedTabsError(message:) after the field was renamed to reason:, breaking the Swift build.
prs.rule: Hand-written Swift/Kotlin wrappers must compile against freshly generated bindings on every PR touching UDL/exports.
prs.detect: CI: build the Swift wrapper sources (MozillaTestServices) on PRs that touch *.udl, uniffi exports or ios/ dirs, not only on full-ci/nightly.

prs.title: Refactor autofill so it doesn't lean as heavily on sync15::Payload
prs.bug: Refactor of autofill payload handling.

prs.title: Fixes missing titles in iOS history migration
prs.bug: iOS history migration kept existing moz_places rows without titles even when titles were available.

prs.title: Fixes name conflict in swift generated code
prs.bug: tabs exported a `Guid` custom type that collided with places' Guid in the shared Swift module, breaking firefox-ios.
prs.rule: Top-level names exported by components that share one Swift module must be unique.
prs.detect: Same cross-component Swift name-uniqueness check as #5293.

prs.title: Sync Manager syncs engines in a deterministic order, fixes #5171
prs.bug: Sync manager synced engines in HashMap order, i.e. nondeterministically, instead of desktop's priority order.
prs.rule: Don't iterate HashMap/HashSet where the order is observable.
prs.detect: Enable clippy::iter_over_hash_type (restriction) in sync_manager/sync15; noise on order-insensitive loops needs #[allow].

prs.title: Fixup regression in calculating install dates

prs.title: Run Rust 1.61 tests with -j2 to prevent OOM
prs.bug: Rust 1.61 min-version tests OOMed on CI.

prs.bug: The iOS CI build lacked a `python` symlink.

prs.title: Fix tab example's use of sync key

prs.title: Adds missing musl-gcc to nimbus-fml build script

prs.rule: CI shell scripts must run with `set -euo pipefail`.
prs.detect: CI script: every *.sh under automation/, taskcluster/scripts/, components/**/scripts must contain `set -e` (ideally -euo pipefail) before the first command; the missing toolchain itself is not lintable.

prs.title: [93.5 fix] Remove tests on expired metrics

prs.rule: Fail CI ahead of Glean metric expiry.
prs.detect: CI script over all metrics.yaml: error if `expires` is a date within N days (or a version <= next release), so metrics are renewed or tests removed before branches break.

prs.bug: Branch-build support for owners/robolectric.

prs.title: Fixes map on String and Variables being internal in Nimbus ios
prs.bug: Swift extensions on String/Variables used by FML-generated code were internal, so generated code failed to compile in consumer modules.
prs.rule: FML-generated Swift/Kotlin must be compiled in a separate module from Nimbus in CI.
prs.detect: Test-harness: compile FML-generated fixtures (nimbus-fml/test/*.swift) as a separate Swift module that only imports Nimbus, so internal symbols referenced by generated code fail the build.

prs.title: Fixup missing mapper when working with optionals
prs.bug: FML codegen dropped the value mapper for optional enum/object types.

prs.bug: Option<DeviceType> made unknown device types awkward to (de)serialize and roundtrip; switched to a non-optional DeviceType with Unknown.

prs.title: Fix gradle builds for Apple Silicon running arm64 JDKs
prs.bug: Gradle builds failed on Apple Silicon arm64 JDKs (no darwin-aarch64 target/libs).

rules.title: Require MPL headers and Cargo license fields
rules.problem: Files without the MPL header and crates without `license` in Cargo.toml block or dirty vendoring into mozilla-central, whose linters catch them only after the fact.
rules.rule: Every tracked source/config file starts with the MPL-2.0 header (after an optional shebang); every workspace Cargo.toml declares license = "MPL-2.0".
rules.detect: Script over `git ls-files` checking the first lines for the MPL header (allowlist generated/third-party paths); `cargo metadata --no-deps | jq` asserting license == MPL-2.0 for every package.
rules.false_positive_risk: low - deterministic text check with an allowlist

rules.title: Keep executable bits and shebangs consistent
rules.problem: Data files committed as executable and shell scripts without shebangs trip m-c's file-perms linter.
rules.rule: A file is executable iff it starts with `#!`; non-script extensions (png, yml, json, md) are never executable.
rules.detect: `git ls-files -s`: mode 100755 => first two bytes must be '#!'; mode 100755 with a data extension => error.
rules.false_positive_risk: low - purely mechanical

rules.title: Fail CI on unused crate dependencies
rules.problem: Leftover deps (glean-build, ffi-support, nss_build_common) inflate builds and license/dependency summaries.
rules.rule: Component manifests must not declare unused dependencies or build-dependencies.
rules.detect: `cargo machete` (fast, stable) or `cargo +nightly udeps` per workspace member, with a `[package.metadata.cargo-machete] ignored` escape hatch.
rules.false_positive_risk: medium - build.rs-only or feature-gated deps need ignore entries

rules.title: Check dependency requirements against mozilla-central
rules.problem: Requiring newer crate versions than m-c vendors (regex 1.10) or manifest features m-c cannot vendor (workspace inheritance at the time) breaks vendoring into Firefox.
rules.rule: Every dependency requirement must be satisfiable by m-c's vendored Cargo.lock, and manifests must stay vendorable.
rules.detect: Script comparing each Cargo.toml requirement's minimum version against a pinned copy of m-c's Cargo.lock (semver per crate); periodic job running `mach vendor rust` against an m-c checkout.
rules.false_positive_risk: low - exact version comparison; needs the m-c lock snapshot refreshed

rules.title: Don't mix // and /// inside doc blocks
rules.problem: A `//` line inside a `///` block silently disappears from the published docs of an exported function.
rules.rule: Doc comment blocks must use `///` (or `//!`) on every line.
rules.false_positive_risk: low - the pattern is rarely intentional

rules.title: Keep docs/SUMMARY.md complete and link-clean
rules.problem: New guides were not added to SUMMARY.md (never published) and SUMMARY.md linked to deleted pages.
rules.rule: Every docs page is reachable from SUMMARY.md (or allowlisted) and every SUMMARY link resolves.
rules.detect: mdbook-linkcheck plus a script diffing SUMMARY.md link targets against `git ls-files 'docs/**/*.md'`.
rules.false_positive_risk: low - allowlist intentionally unlisted pages

rules.title: Run shellcheck and require strict mode in scripts
rules.problem: Scripts referenced unset variables or kept going after failed steps, silently producing broken or missing artifacts.
rules.rule: All *.sh pass shellcheck and begin with `set -euo pipefail` (or at least `set -e`).
rules.detect: shellcheck on `git ls-files '*.sh'` (SC2154 catches $DOC_DIR); grep that each script contains `set -e` before its first command.
rules.false_positive_risk: low - sourced setup scripts may need `# shellcheck shell=bash` directives

rules.title: Make Python automation exit non-zero on failure
rules.problem: Automation scripts ignored subprocess return codes or a False status, so failed vendoring or symbol uploads reported success.
rules.rule: subprocess.run uses check=True or inspects returncode; bool status results are not discarded; main() exits non-zero on failure.
rules.detect: ruff PLW1510 (subprocess-run-without-check) on automation/, tools/, taskcluster/; a small custom AST check flagging expression-statement calls to local functions that only return bool literals.
rules.false_positive_risk: low for PLW1510; medium for the custom ignored-bool check

rules.title: Default Option fields and args to None in UniFFI APIs
rules.problem: Optional Record fields and constructor/method args without defaults force every Kotlin/Swift caller to pass them, which turns additions into breaking changes.
rules.rule: Option<T> fields of uniffi Records and Option<T> args of exported functions declare `default = None` unless explicitly opted out.
rules.detect: syn-based scan of `#[derive(uniffi::Record)]` structs and `#[uniffi::export]` impls (and UDL `T?` members without `= null`), reporting Option-typed items without a default.
rules.false_positive_risk: medium - some Options are intentionally required; needs an opt-out attribute or comment

rules.title: Give catch-all FFI error variants a reason
rules.problem: `FxaError::Other` had no payload, so consumers only saw 'other error'.
rules.rule: Catch-all variants (Other, Unexpected*, Unknown*) of public/FFI error enums must carry a reason string that is interpolated in the message.
rules.detect: Scan enums deriving uniffi::Error/thiserror::Error that are exported (or UDL [Error] interfaces): flag such variants with no fields or an `#[error]` format string without interpolation.
rules.false_positive_risk: low - name-based and narrow

rules.title: Use execute_batch for multi-statement SQL
rules.problem: A migration passed two statements to execute(), which ran only the first, leaving upgraded databases without a table.
rules.rule: SQL passed to execute/execute_cached/prepare/query_* must contain exactly one statement.
rules.detect: ast-grep/dylint: string-literal or const &str arguments to those methods containing `;` followed by another SQL keyword (CREATE/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DROP/ALTER).
rules.false_positive_risk: low - trailing semicolons and semicolons inside string literals/triggers need handling

rules.title: Test every schema migration against a fresh schema
rules.problem: Migrations diverged from fresh schemas, schema versions weren't bumped, and clear_database() missed tables added later.
rules.rule: Each component with migrations has (a) a fresh-vs-migrated schema equality test, (b) a test that clear_database() empties every table not on an allowlist, and (c) a VERSION bump whenever schema SQL or upgrade code changes.
rules.detect: Shared sql_support helper (MigratedDatabaseFile::run_all_upgrades + assert_schema_matches_new_database), a clear_database test that iterates sqlite_master, and a CI diff check that fails when schema SQL/upgrade_from changes without the VERSION constant changing.
rules.false_positive_risk: low - tests are deterministic; the diff check may need an override label for comment-only edits

rules.title: Require explicit ON DELETE on every foreign key
rules.problem: A REFERENCES clause without ON DELETE CASCADE caused FOREIGN KEY failures when re-ingesting suggestions.
rules.rule: Every REFERENCES/FOREIGN KEY clause states an ON DELETE action.
rules.detect: Schema test: on a fresh DB run `PRAGMA foreign_key_list(t)` for each table and fail when on_delete == 'NO ACTION' unless allowlisted.
rules.false_positive_risk: low - an intentional NO ACTION can be spelled explicitly

rules.title: Commit or explicitly roll back every transaction
rules.problem: A function opened unchecked_transaction(), wrote to it and returned without commit(), so the write was silently rolled back on drop.
rules.rule: A transaction bound in a function must be committed, explicitly rolled back, or returned/moved to the caller.
rules.detect: ast-grep/dylint: `let $TX = $DB.(unchecked_transaction|transaction|begin_transaction)()?` where the body has no `$TX.commit()`/`$TX.rollback()` and `$TX` is not returned or passed by value.
rules.false_positive_risk: medium - intentional read-only guard transactions need an #[allow]

rules.title: Deny unwrap/expect in component library code
rules.problem: An `unwrap()` inside a query_map closure (already marked XXX) panicked on bad rows during sync.
rules.rule: Non-test component code must propagate errors instead of unwrap()/expect(), except for documented invariants.
rules.detect: `#![cfg_attr(not(test), warn(clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::expect_used))]` per component, ratcheted to deny with a baseline of existing #[allow]s; also grep for `unwrap()` on lines carrying XXX/TODO.
rules.false_positive_risk: high at first (mutex locks, invariants) - needs a baseline and ratchet

rules.title: Use checked arithmetic in JEXL/targeting code
rules.problem: usize::MAX + starting_bucket overflowed in an eventLastSeen transform; the panic poisoned the JEXL evaluator mutex.
rules.rule: Code reachable from JEXL transforms and other FFI entry points uses checked/saturating arithmetic and must not panic.
rules.detect: Enable clippy::arithmetic_side_effects, clippy::panic and clippy::indexing_slicing for components/nimbus/src/stateful/{behavior,targeting}.rs; add a test that runs every transform with boundary args (0, usize::MAX, negatives).
rules.false_positive_risk: medium - arithmetic_side_effects is noisy outside a narrow scope

rules.title: Truncate strings only at char boundaries
rules.problem: String::truncate at a byte limit panicked on multi-byte tab titles.
rules.rule: Don't call String::truncate or slice &str with arbitrary byte indexes; use a char-boundary-safe helper.
rules.detect: clippy.toml `disallowed-methods = [{ path = "alloc::string::String::truncate", reason = "use slice_up_to / floor_char_boundary" }]` plus `clippy::string_slice` (restriction) in components.
rules.false_positive_risk: medium - ASCII-only call sites need an #[allow]

rules.title: Use ordered maps where iteration order is observable
rules.problem: HashMap iteration made FML output nondeterministic and sync engine order random, and tests relied on serde_json Map order that only came from workspace feature unification.
rules.rule: Code generators, serialized manifests and ordered workflows must not iterate HashMap/HashSet; tests must not depend on map order the crate itself doesn't guarantee.
rules.detect: clippy::iter_over_hash_type in nimbus-fml and sync_manager, plus `disallowed-types` HashMap/HashSet in nimbus-fml's clippy.toml; a CI job running `cargo test -p <crate>` per crate (or cargo-hack --each-package) to expose feature-unification dependence.
rules.false_positive_risk: medium - many hash iterations are order-insensitive and need #[allow]

rules.title: Keep tests independent of the current date
rules.problem: Event-store tests built dates from Utc::now(), so they failed across Jan 1 or passed only on Mondays.
rules.rule: Tests use fixed or injected timestamps instead of the wall clock when doing calendar arithmetic.
rules.detect: Lint #[cfg(test)] code for `Utc::now()`, `SystemTime::now()` or `Timestamp::now()` near calendar ops (Duration::days, with_month, Interval::Weeks/Months); weekly CI run under libfaketime at Dec 31 23:59 and on different weekdays.
rules.false_positive_risk: high for a blanket now() ban; medium when scoped to calendar math

rules.title: Serialize tests that touch global state
rules.problem: Tests sharing static mocks, the global logger/max level or named shared-cache in-memory DBs raced when cargo ran them in parallel.
rules.rule: Tests that use mockall static contexts, set_logger/set_max_level or other globals take a shared lock or are #[serial]; named in-memory DB URIs are unique per test.
rules.detect: Per test module: if any test takes a lock/#[serial], flag tests calling the same global APIs (`*_context()`, set_logger, set_max_level) without it; rg for duplicate `file:NAME?mode=memory&cache=shared` literals.
rules.false_positive_risk: medium - module-local heuristics

rules.title: Build Swift wrappers with warnings as errors
rules.problem: Infinite recursion, unused results and deprecated APIs in Swift wrappers shipped to consumers; the compiler warned about each.
rules.rule: Hand-written Swift wrapper code compiles warning-free in CI.
rules.detect: xcodebuild for MozillaTestServices with SWIFT_TREAT_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS=YES (or swiftc -warnings-as-errors on wrapper sources), plus SwiftLint.
rules.false_positive_risk: low-medium - SDK deprecations after Xcode bumps need prompt fixes

rules.title: Keep exported names unique across one Swift module
rules.problem: Components bundled into the single MozillaRustComponents Swift module exported the same top-level names (create_key, Guid), breaking firefox-ios.
rules.rule: Top-level functions, types and custom typedefs exported by components that share a Swift module must have unique names.
rules.detect: Generate Swift bindings for every iOS megazord component in library mode, collect top-level public declarations per component and fail on duplicates (or compile all generated files together on every PR touching UDL/exports).
rules.false_positive_risk: low - any duplicate is a real compile error

rules.title: Check megazord manifests, headers and uniffi.toml agree
rules.problem: Components missing cdylib_name=megazord, missing re-exports or FFI headers, or headers absent from module.modulemap broke Fenix, Focus iOS and firefox-ios builds.
rules.rule: Every UniFFI component in a megazord's dependency closure has cdylib_name = "megazord" (Kotlin), a `pub use` in the megazord lib.rs, an `#import` in the umbrella header, and every built header is listed in module.modulemap.
rules.detect: Script using `cargo metadata` for megazords/full and megazords/ios-rust(/focus): parse each component's uniffi.toml, grep lib.rs and MozillaRustComponents.h; after the xcframework build, check Headers/*.h against Modules/module.modulemap.
rules.false_positive_risk: low - set comparisons over explicit manifests

rules.title: Compile wrappers and FML output against fresh bindings
rules.problem: Hand-written Swift used a renamed error field, and FML-generated Swift relied on internal Nimbus extensions; both surfaced only in consumer builds.
rules.rule: Every PR touching UDL/uniffi exports or FML codegen compiles the Kotlin/Swift wrappers and compiles FML-generated code as a separate consumer module.
rules.detect: Path-filtered CI job: build the Swift wrapper sources against freshly generated bindings, and compile nimbus-fml test fixtures in a module that only `import`s Nimbus.
rules.false_positive_risk: low - compile errors are real; the cost is macOS CI time

rules.title: Detect breaking changes in Kotlin/Swift APIs
rules.problem: A new required init parameter on SyncUnlockInfo broke firefox-ios without being flagged.
rules.rule: Public API changes to Kotlin/Swift wrappers and generated bindings are diffed against the last release; breaking diffs need a CHANGELOG breaking-change entry.
rules.detect: Kotlin binary-compatibility-validator (apiDump/apiCheck) and swift-api-digester -dump-sdk/-diagnose-sdk against the previous release tag.
rules.false_positive_risk: medium - intended breaks need a baseline update

rules.title: Validate the taskgraph for every parameter set on PRs
rules.problem: Decision-task crashes, duplicated artifacts and copy-pasted index routes only showed up in push or nightly graphs.
rules.rule: PRs touching taskcluster/ generate the full graph for every params file, and index routes are unique across tasks.
rules.detect: `taskgraph full -p taskcluster/test/params/*.yml`; post-process the JSON to assert unique `index.*` routes and no file listed in both artifacts and release-artifacts.
rules.false_positive_risk: low - checks run over generated graph JSON

rules.title: Make the dependency-summary check required
rules.problem: Auto-merge only waited for run-tests, so PRs landed with stale DEPENDENCIES.md.
rules.rule: The dependency-summary/audit job is a required status for PRs changing Cargo.lock or manifests and also runs on a schedule.
rules.detect: Branch-protection/mergify rule requiring the dependency-check job; the job runs `tools/dependency_summary.py --check`.
rules.false_positive_risk: low

rules.title: Pin formatter and linter versions in CI
rules.problem: An unpinned swiftformat upgrade started failing CI on unchanged code.
rules.rule: CI installs swiftformat, swiftlint, ktlint and the Rust toolchain at pinned versions.
rules.detect: Pin via mint/Package.swift or brew version pins, plus rust-toolchain.toml; the lint job fails if `--version` differs from the pin.
rules.false_positive_risk: low

rules.title: Make sync payloads tolerate null and roundtrip
rules.problem: Explicit nulls for #[serde(default)] String fields failed deserialization, and unknown enum values deserialized but could not serialize.
rules.rule: Incoming sync payload fields with #[serde(default)] also accept null, and payload types roundtrip through serde, including unknown enum values.
rules.detect: Custom lint for non-Option #[serde(default)] fields without a null-tolerant deserialize_with in sync record structs; roundtrip tests (deserialize -> serialize -> deserialize) fed nulls and unknown enum strings per payload type.
rules.false_positive_risk: medium - field-level heuristics

rules.title: Warn before Glean metrics expire
rules.problem: Metrics expired on a release branch and the tests exercising them started failing.
rules.rule: CI fails when a metric in any metrics.yaml expires within N days or by the next release version.
rules.detect: Script parsing every metrics.yaml `expires` field (date or version) and comparing it with today+N days or the next version in version.txt.
rules.false_positive_risk: low

rules.title: Check isHierarchical before reading URI query params
rules.problem: Calling query-parameter APIs on opaque URIs throws UnsupportedOperationException, which crashed Fenix.
rules.rule: Kotlin code calls Uri.getQueryParameter*/queryParameterNames only after checking uri.isHierarchical.
rules.detect: Custom detekt rule flagging those calls in functions that never reference `isHierarchical`.
rules.false_positive_risk: medium - guards in callers aren't visible to a function-local rule
